security_audit.summary: All 44 static findings were false positives after context review: they are documentation text, AWS resource references, generated IaC template strings, or links to AWS resources rather than credential access, shell execution, reconnaissance, or runtime networking. I found no prompt injection or data-exfiltration intent. The generated IaC still needs hardening for unsanitized app-name interpolation and broad CORS defaults.

remediation.issue: Unvalidated app names are interpolated into generated IaC.
remediation.suggestion: Validate app_name and region against AWS resource naming patterns, and escape YAML, TypeScript, and HCL strings before output.

remediation.issue: Generated API templates default to broad CORS policies.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit allowed origins and methods, and document production values for each environment.

remediation.issue: Production security defaults are lenient in generated examples.
remediation.suggestion: Use stricter password settings and required MFA for production profiles, or clearly label relaxed settings as development defaults.

semantic_findings.title: Unsanitized App Name Interpolation in Generated IaC
semantic_findings.description: serverless_stack.py only lowercases app_name and replaces spaces before inserting it into YAML, TypeScript, and HCL templates. A crafted app name with quotes or newlines could alter generated infrastructure code if a user deploys it.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The constructor performs minimal normalization and the same value is interpolated into multiple generated template languages. Exploitability depends on users deploying output generated from untrusted names.

semantic_findings.title: Broad CORS Defaults in Generated API Templates
semantic_findings.description: The generated CloudFormation template defaults CorsAllowedOrigins to wildcard, and the CDK template allows all origins and methods. These defaults can produce overly permissive APIs when used without production review.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The permissive defaults are directly present in generated IaC. The impact is limited by Cognito authorization, but cross-origin policy should still be explicit for production APIs.

content.value_statement: Startups need AWS designs that scale without early overbuild. This skill recommends architectures, IaC starters, and cost controls for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Recommends AWS architecture patterns from application type, traffic, budget, team size, and compliance needs.
Generates starter CloudFormation, AWS CDK TypeScript, and Terraform templates for serverless APIs.
Models Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Cognito, S3, CloudFront, ECS, RDS, and event-driven services.
Estimates monthly cost ranges and identifies optimization actions across compute, storage, database, networking, and logs.
Provides startup scaling stages, implementation phases, monitoring guidance, and AWS security best practices.
limitations: It does not query live AWS accounts or verify current AWS pricing automatically.
Generated templates need review, validation, and security hardening before deployment.
Some scripts referenced in the documentation are not included in the package.
Cost estimates are rule-based approximations and require confirmation in AWS tools.

use_cases.title: Plan an MVP Cloud Architecture
use_cases.description: Create a practical AWS design for an early product with budget limits, simple operations, and room to scale.

use_cases.title: Generate Serverless IaC Starters
use_cases.description: Produce starter CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform structures for API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, and Cognito.

use_cases.title: Reduce AWS Spend
use_cases.description: Review current resource descriptions and identify cost savings from idle compute, storage policies, networking, and commitments.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Basic Serverless MVP
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an AWS serverless architecture for a new web app with 5,000 monthly users, a small team, and a 300 USD monthly budget.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Architecture Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare serverless, ECS Fargate, and three-tier AWS architectures for a SaaS app with 50,000 users and SOC 2 goals.

prompt_templates.title: Create IaC Starter Templates
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an infrastructure plan for a serverless API using Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Cognito, CloudWatch, and separate dev and production environments.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize an Existing AWS Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this AWS resource inventory and monthly spend. Recommend cost reductions, security improvements, scaling risks, and a phased remediation plan.

output_examples.input: Design a mobile backend for 100,000 users with authentication, file uploads, push notifications, and a 1,500 USD monthly budget.
output: Recommends AppSync or API Gateway with Lambda for backend APIs.
Uses Cognito for authentication, S3 with CloudFront for uploads, and SNS Mobile Push for notifications.
Provides estimated monthly cost ranges, scaling notes, and operational tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: Optimize a startup AWS account that uses EC2, RDS, S3, DynamoDB, NAT Gateways, and CloudWatch Logs.
output: Highlights idle EC2 and RDS resources, missing lifecycle policies, and high NAT Gateway costs.
Prioritizes high-savings actions and separates immediate, weekly, monthly, and ongoing work.
Explains which recommendations need validation before production changes.

output_examples.input: Create a serverless API infrastructure starter for a product launch.
output: Produces a deployable architecture outline with Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Cognito, and CloudWatch.
Includes starter IaC options and a checklist for validation, security review, and environment configuration.

best_practices: Provide traffic, data size, compliance, budget, and team experience before asking for an architecture.
Review generated IaC with AWS security, naming, quota, and environment requirements before deployment.
Validate cost estimates with AWS pricing tools and real usage data before committing to a plan.
anti_patterns: Deploying generated templates unchanged into production.
Asking for an architecture with no scale, data, security, or budget context.
Treating rule-based cost estimates as a fixed AWS bill forecast.

faq.question: Does this skill connect to my AWS account?
faq.answer: No. It works from requirements and resource descriptions that you provide.

faq.question: Can it generate infrastructure as code?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes starter CloudFormation, AWS CDK, and Terraform output for serverless API patterns.

faq.question: Are the generated templates production ready?
faq.answer: No. Treat them as starters that require validation, security review, naming cleanup, and environment-specific configuration.

faq.question: Can it estimate AWS costs?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides approximate cost ranges and optimization recommendations based on supplied resource details.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide application type, expected users, traffic, data needs, compliance requirements, budget, region, and team experience.
